messages:
emma: Thanks for joining the all-hands today — quick follow-up thread for items we said we'd surface. Recording + slides below. I'll post owners for open asks in replies.

raj: Thanks! can you drop the link to the infra roadmap bit? I missed that section.

emma: sure — infra roadmap slides: https://redwood-inference.com/slides/q1-infra-roadmap.pdf

sofia: noted re: evals automation — I'll own the pilot. will add a checklist doc. @jenny_prod can you pair on acceptance criteria?

jenny_prod: yep, happy to. will add criteria to the doc and ping QA.

mike_eng: question on Dedicated capacity rollout — timeline 2H or earlier? the chart looked like "late Q2".

emma: Dedicated GA still targeted for late Q2 but we're accelerating capacity testing. mike_eng — can you and chris_sre sync with infra next week? assign: mike_eng, chris_sre.

chris_sre: on it. I'll schedule a 30m sync and add meeting notes to /internals/infra/dedicated-rollout

ops-bot: Deploy started: canary/deploy-4729 on infra-staging at 2024-11-02T15:22:10Z :rocket:

raj: one more ask — can we get the cost-optimization playbook link? slides mentioned caching suggestions.

sofia: cost playbook draft: https://redwood-inference.com/ops/cost-playbook-v0.9.md — note it's a draft.

emma: action items collected: 1) Sofia to run evals pilot (owner: sofia) 2) Jenny to add acceptance criteria (owner: jenny_prod) 3) Mike+Chris infra sync (owners: mike_eng, chris_sre) 4) Docs: add recording/slides to handbook (owner: raj) 5) Cost playbook PR (owner: sofia)

jenny_prod: added acceptance criteria section: https://redwood-inference.com/docs/evals-pilot#acceptance

raj: I'll upload recording + slides to handbook by EOD. ping me if you're blocked.

mike_eng: scheduled infra sync Thu 9am PT, calendar invite sent to @chris_sre @emma

sofia: creating evals pilot repo and first draft test set, linking here when ready.

emma: thanks everyone. if anything else comes up drop here. :thumbsup:
